releases.notes:
Added:
- Code Forge: C#, Python and C++ editor with live problem checking, and an Explorer for your workspace.
- Flash Bay: flash ESP32 boards without extra tools, write auto-connect settings, upload MicroPython scripts.
- Serial Monitor, and Link Hub: robots connect over Wi-Fi, USB or this PC's own Bluetooth LE.
- Robot screens with a real-size 3D twin, telemetry graphs, packets and logs; the MG90S servo is built in.
- Control Deck: on-screen controls for each robot, gamepads and ESP32 controllers, Python / C# / C++ deck scripts.
- Neural Lab: robot brains, generated for your robot or loaded from fruit-fly connectome data with credit kept.
- Packages: share robot setups as .spider files, each item with its own licence.
- Virtual robots and a virtual servo, to try every screen without hardware.
- Signed updates: S.P.I.D.E.R. offers new versions and checks every download before installing.
- User agreement, shown on first start and again when it changes.
